caption:
WordPress has a built-in checkup. 🩺

Dashboard > Tools > Site Health
- Status tab: critical issues and recommended improvements
- Info tab: server and version details, handy when asking your host for help

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#wordpress #wordpresstips #website #sitehealth #webmaster #maintenance #webdev #techtips #bloggingtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Does your site need a checkup?
scenes.say: Does your site need a checkup? WordPress has one built in.

scenes.title: Open Site Health
scenes.say: Open your WordPress dashboard. Click Tools. Then click Site Health.

scenes.title: Fix critical issues first
scenes.body: Then work through the recommended improvements.
scenes.say: On the Status tab, you see critical issues and recommended improvements. Fix the critical ones first.

scenes.title: Handy when asking for help
scenes.body: Shows your versions and server details.
scenes.say: The Info tab shows your versions and server details. That is handy when you ask your host for help.
Do not wait for a problem. Check once a month and fix things calmly.
